commits.message:
Change asian dressing image

Prior asian sesame dressing was from wordpress and had some rendering
markup included in it. Changed to a different image witih a basic dumb
URL which should now work when referenced from a different domain /
server.

Add content to the ingredients pages

Added an image, description, ingredients and directions to the 3 recipe
pages. Organized a little bit with h3s, h4s, ordered and unordered lists
and now ready to publish it to the web through it.

Establish initial file structure for 3 recipes

Added index.html and 3 initial recipe files. Each file only contains
the HTML boilerplate with an h1 and the index having links to the
other files. Tomorrow will add content to the pages.

Add the initial draft of the landing page

This is the first (and probably last) version of this landing page,
including images and assets. I'm also going to test if I did this
commit message properly!

Add UI for the rock paper scissors assignment

Most complex project yet! Added full UI including buttons, text and
images. Also added lots of listeners and functionality to receive the
player's input and then changing DOM to reflect it in scores and text.

Big thing I've learned is for eventListeners, this points at the object
that contains the listener, while target is where you click. BIG diff.

Add first iteration of Rock Paper Scissors

Continues to loop until either player or computer attains a score of 5.
Console will display results of each round as well as the final
outcome and scores of player and computer.

Add domain manipulation examples

First little bits of DOM manipulation using javascript.
All core features seem to work
